title: From problem to product
description: Engineering projects from Gandaki College of Engineering and Science, from problem framing and research through system design and wireframes.

items.title: Shopping Buddy
items.tagline: An e-commerce platform that gives small businesses and local sellers their own online storefront.
items.institution: Gandaki College of Engineering and Science · Pokhara University
items.overview: Shopping Buddy is an e-commerce application with user-friendly interfaces for browsing products, adding items to a cart, and checking out securely. It covers registration, login, product search and filtering, payment processing, and online transactions. Personalized product recommendations and a refund flow make customers happier, and a responsive design with secure data handling keeps shopping smooth.
items.problem: Small businesses and local sellers often lack their own platform to sell online. Small and medium-sized businesses also struggle to deliver personalized shopping experiences, manage inventory efficiently, and use customer data to improve sales.
items.objective: Provide a platform for small businesses and local products with secure payments and personalized recommendations.
items.impact: Gives small businesses a secure place to sell online, with personalized recommendations, refunds, and wider reach. This brings in more customers, increases sales, and promotes local products.

highlights.title: Seller storefronts
highlights.description: Local sellers add, edit, and delete products, manage inventory, and view sales analytics.

highlights.title: Personalized recommendations
highlights.description: TensorFlow-powered suggestions surface relevant products to every customer.

highlights.title: Secure checkout
highlights.description: Multiple payment methods, shipping addresses, and protected online transactions.

highlights.title: Refund services
highlights.description: An efficient refund flow that keeps customer trust and satisfaction high.

highlights.title: Search & filtering
highlights.description: Customers search, filter, and view detailed product information before buying.

highlights.title: Admin control
highlights.description: Admins manage accounts, sellers, and orders, and review analytics reports.

actors.name: Customer
actors.description: Creates an account, searches products, manages the cart, checks out with a chosen payment method and shipping address, and views order history.

actors.name: Seller
actors.description: Logs in to add, edit, and delete products, manage inventory, and track sales analytics.

actors.name: Admin
actors.description: Manages accounts, sellers, and orders, and views analytics reports across the platform.

research.intro: We studied established platforms in Nepal and abroad to learn what local shoppers expect and where small sellers are underserved.

items.name: Daraz
items.description: Nepal's leading marketplace. It brought practices like cash-on-delivery, flash sales, and easy returns to the market.

items.name: SastoDeal
items.description: Focuses on affordable pricing and partners with local vendors to promote Nepali products.

items.name: Hamro Bazar
items.description: A peer-to-peer classifieds marketplace. It is simple to use but does not handle payments or delivery.

items.name: Thulo.com
items.description: Supports Nepali SMEs with warehousing, logistics, and digital marketing services.

items.name: Foodmandu
items.description: Nepal's first online food delivery platform. Known for a user-friendly interface and efficient delivery.

items.name: Alibaba
items.description: A global B2B marketplace that connects manufacturers and suppliers with buyers worldwide.

approach.name: Agile methodology
approach.intro: Development and testing run continuously. The work is split into phases, with constant stakeholder collaboration and a repeating cycle of planning, executing, and evaluating.

items.title: Explorify
items.tagline: An AI-powered travel companion that recommends destinations based on your interests and mood.
items.institution: Gandaki College of Engineering and Science · Pokhara University
items.overview: Explorify is a recommendation system that uses AI and machine learning to help travelers find places and activities that match their interests. It learns from past choices, preferences, and feedback, and its suggestions improve over time. Beyond recommendations, it is a full travel companion: destination search, maps, itineraries, travel partners, checklists, expense tracking, and a trip gallery.
items.problem: Travel planning takes time and can be overwhelming, and travelers struggle to find destinations that suit them. Trips with family or friends add more to handle: itineraries, budgets, attractions, accommodation, and transport.
items.objective: Provide personalized travel recommendations that improve the user experience and make trip planning simpler.
items.impact: Saves travelers time with relevant suggestions and better decisions. It also supports tourism by promoting lesser-known destinations, which spreads visitors more evenly.

highlights.title: Smart recommendations
highlights.description: ML-driven suggestions based on past visits, preferences, and popular trends.

highlights.title: Recommend by mood
highlights.description: Pick a mood like adventurous, romantic, or relaxed to get matching destinations, such as bungee jumping or paragliding.

highlights.title: Maps & itineraries
highlights.description: Explore destinations on a map and build day-by-day trip plans.

highlights.title: Travel partners
highlights.description: Coordinate trips with friends and family in one shared space.

highlights.title: Checklists & expenses
highlights.description: Prepare packing checklists and track the trip budget as you go.

highlights.title: Trip gallery
highlights.description: Upload and relive the trip's photos and videos.

actors.name: Recommended by category
actors.description: Choose a category to see destinations tailored to your preferences, past visits, or popular trends.

actors.name: View destination details
actors.description: See location, duration, cost, scenery, reviews, and accommodation for any destination.

actors.name: Add to favorites
actors.description: Save destinations to a personal list stored on your profile for later.

actors.name: Recommend by mood
actors.description: Pick a mood to get matching destinations, or similar moods when nothing matches.

research.intro: The design draws on recent research into recommender systems for tourism.

items.name: Bansal & Agarwal (2021)
items.description: Travel recommendation systems: A survey and taxonomy.

items.name: Chen & Zhang (2020)
items.description: A machine learning approach for personalized travel recommendations.

items.name: Liu & Xu (2020)
items.description: Using deep learning to improve personalized travel recommendations.

items.name: Wang & Zhang (2023)
items.description: Context-aware travel recommendation using collaborative filtering and deep learning.

approach.name: Agile model
approach.intro: Features ship in short two-to-four-week cycles. Each increment is tested continuously and released early so feedback comes in quickly.
